### 8A.2cr — AI board: a task that isn't done stands out on the review page · Normal

```text
Follow @docs/roadmap/claude-code-prompts.md conventions, except "End of the step" (see the end of this prompt).
Do "AI board: a task that isn't done stands out on the review page (8A.2cr)" from
@docs/roadmap/night-run/small-fix.md. Ola's words (review of night run 2026-11-12, on 8A.2cl): "what does it wait
for??? also not done should be more visible".

Where (Ola, 2026-11-23): the board is the package nightshift-board in ~/Repos/nightshift, not Ludzu. Use skill
tool-change: its own branch in ~/Repos/nightshift, a PR opened and NOT merged (Ola tests it on the board in the
morning, then says "merge"). Ludzu itself doesn't change apart from the screenshots and the tick below.

Checked facts (~/Repos/nightshift):
- public/review.js `taskCard` (line ~159): the title, then chips (id, type, status from `STATUS` at line 8:
  done → good "done", partial → warn "partly done", not-done → bad "not done"), then `Done`, then `Missing`
  (line ~188) as plain `kv` paragraphs. A not-done task looks almost like a done one; its Missing text sits under
  Done.
- Chip colours: public/style.css `.chip.good/.warn/.bad` (line ~229).
- Pure modules with no imports are unit-tested in Node: public/review-save.js + server/review-save.test.mjs.
  `npm test` is `node --test`.

1. Before screenshot: board running on Ludzu (`pnpm board` in ~/Repos/ludzu, port 8095), page
   http://localhost:8095/review on run night-run-2026-11-12, desktop 1280 wide, full page, with Playwright; wait for
   network idle and `document.fonts.ready`, and check it with `isBlankPicture` from nightshift-board. Save to
   ~/Repos/ludzu/docs/screenshots/8A.2cr/before/review-night-run-2026-11-12.png.
2. New pure module public/task-attention.js, `taskAttention(task)` → null for status "done" with no `missing`;
   otherwise `{ tone, label, text }`:
   - status "not-done" and `missing` starting with "Waits" or "Waiting" (any case) → `warn`, "Waiting";
   - status "not-done" → `bad`, "Not done";
   - status "partial" → `warn`, "Partly done";
   - status "done" with a `missing` text → `warn`, "Done, something left";
   - `text` is `task.missing` (null when there is none).
3. public/review.js `taskCard`: when `taskAttention` gives a value, the card gets class `attention-<tone>` (a 4 px
   left border in that tone's colour), a large chip with the label as the first chip, and the `text` right under the
   title in a tinted box of the same tone (instead of the `Missing` paragraph further down). Done tasks look as
   today. The old small status chip stays for done tasks only. Styles in public/style.css, using the existing
   --good/--warn/--bad and their -soft variables (light and dark).
4. Unit tests, server/task-attention.test.mjs: `a done task needs no attention`, `not done with a Waits text is
   Waiting`, `not done is Not done`, `partly done is Partly done`, `done with something missing is flagged`,
   `the text is the missing text`.
5. After screenshot: same as step 1 (the board loads the branch through tool-change's test setup), to
   ~/Repos/ludzu/docs/screenshots/8A.2cr/after/review-night-run-2026-11-12.png. On it, "Admin Health: show and run
   the black box check" shows "Waiting" with "Waits for 8A.2ck green on Development." under its title.
```
